newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Brooke Bond books to close for merger.
newsitem.headline: Brooke Bond books to close for merger.

text.p: Brooke Bond Pakistan Ltd said on Thursday its books will close from June 11-17 for a merger with Lever Brothers Pakistan Ltd.
The two companies announced the merger on Tuesday after approval of the Sindh High Court in southern Pakistan.
For purposes of the merger, 4.3 10-rupee ordinary shares of Brooke Bond would be equal to one 50-rupee ordinary share of Lever Brothers, a Brooke Bond executive said.
The merged company will trade as Lever Brothers, effective from May 19, company officials have said.

Lever manufactures and markets a variety of consumer items, including cooking oil, soaps, detergents and ice cream. Brooke Bond processes and markets tea, mostly imported from abroad, and rice, pickles and spices.
The two companies are considered blue chips on the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE).
